title: Show apartment released
body: Final joinery is complete and the first show apartment has been handed over to the sales team.

title: Envelope works complete
body: The building is now weather-tight. First-fix MEP is progressing across levels two to five.

title: Planning submission validated
body: The full planning submission has been validated by Cheshire East Council and consultation is under way.

title: Practical completion forecast confirmed
body: The project team has reconfirmed practical completion for September following the latest programme review.

title: Superstructure reaches third floor
body: The concrete frame has reached level three and blockwork is following two floors behind. The tower crane comes down in early October.

title: Ground works complete
body: Foundations and drainage are signed off across all plots. The timber-frame erection sequence begins with the garden-square townhouses.
